items.name: Golden Carrot Crumb
items.desc: A beautifully spiced carrot cake with a tender crumb and luscious cream cheese frosting.
items.ingredients: Sponge: freshly grated carrots, toasted pecans, plain flour, sugar, sunflower oil, buttermilk, eggs, cinnamon, vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, salt. Frosting: cream cheese, unsalted butter, icing sugar, vanilla. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten, nuts (pecans).

items.name: Milk Cloud
items.desc: A cloud-soft sponge soaked in three milks, topped with caramel.
items.ingredients: Sponge: eggs, sugar, plain flour, baking powder, vanilla, almond extract, salt. Soaked in sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk and cream. Topped with whipped cream and a caramel of sugar, cream, butter and salt. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten. Flavoured with almond extract.

items.name: Toffee Cuddle
items.desc: Moist, date-infused sticky toffee cake drenched in a rich, buttery caramel.
items.ingredients: Cake: dates, unsalted butter, light and dark brown (muscovado) sugar, egg, self-raising flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, sea salt. Toffee sauce: brown sugar, unsalted butter, cream, sea salt. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten.

items.name: Cinnamon Kisses
items.desc: Soft, fluffy cinnamon-swirl cake with warm cinnamon sugar and a dreamy cream cheese frosting.
items.ingredients: Cake: plain flour, sugar, plain yogurt, melted butter, egg, vanilla, baking powder, salt. Swirl: brown sugar, butter, cinnamon. Frosting: cream cheese, icing sugar. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten.

items.name: Chocolate Crush
items.desc: Rich, decadent chocolate cake layered with irresistible fudge and a smooth, velvety chocolate finish.
items.ingredients: Cake: plain flour, sugar, cocoa, buttermilk, sunflower oil, eggs, freshly brewed coffee, vanilla, baking soda, baking powder, salt. Fudge buttercream: dark chocolate, unsalted butter, egg yolk, icing sugar, vanilla, instant coffee. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten.
